newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares start flat in sluggish bourse.
newsitem.headline: German shares start flat in sluggish bourse.

text.p: German shares moved just ahead in early bourse trade on Monday but, with a softer dollar, were unable to follow the post-bourse rally that occurred on Friday after Wall Street moved to higher levels.

The DAX-30 index of leading German shares gained 6.60 points to 3,365.89 in early dealings. The IBIS DAX electronic trading system, on which Friday's rally had materialised, meanwhile lost 36.57 points to 3,365.72.
"There's nothing to trade on at the moment. The dollar is softer but not greatly changed, and Bunds are pretty steady," said one dealer. The dollar traded at just under 1.6900 marks.
Some traders saw the risk of some consolidation in the market. "Our trading range for the week is between 3,275 and 3,475," said one.
Others noted however that with little going on in the market at the moment, it was difficult to get any meaningful feeling of the current mood among investors.
Chemicals group Henkel fell 1.70 marks, 1.8 percent, to 93.15 in IBIS trade after reporting an increase in 1996 profits that dealers said was nonetheless under some expectations.
In bourse trade, it was quoted at 93.70 marks, 20 pfennigs up on the day.

Machinery maker Deutz surged 2.80 marks, or 21.5 percent, to 15.80 after reporting that following a wide restructuring its 1996 net profit would likely be above 800 million marks -- compared to the 1.1 billion mark loss of 1995.
Among other notable gainers, tyre-manufacturer Continental rose 1.10 marks, 3.1 percent, to 36.50 after giving details of an improved manufacturing process.
Continental said earlier it had devised a "modular manufacturing process" that will slash inventory and other overhead costs. It said savings could be in the range of 50-70 million marks a year.

Deutsche Telekom slipped 50 pfennigs to 36.40. It had earlier said it was making no comment on a British newspaper report that it was considering buying a 14 percent stake in British telecom group Cable & Wireless.
